data.name: Lethal Wedding
data.detailed_description:
Bride Hard!

Say “I do” to Lethal Wedding, a high-octane, top-down RPG shooter where the wedding is off, and the vengeance is on. When a drug ring of criminal clowns kidnaps the groom just one day before the ceremony, it’s up to the bride-to-be and her mother-in-law to get him back. Rescue your future husband as you fight through circus freaks, mafia thugs, and killer clowns in an experience that blends gritty B-movie action with hilarious family friction.

Experience the thrill of commitment with the innovative Vow System. Before entering any of the 30+ levels of carnage, you can pick optional challenges to unlock special rewards. If you want elite upgrades like Speed Reload, you'll have to "vow" to face enemies with bonus damage and increased movement speed. Master these risk-vs-reward modifiers to build a character capable of uncovering the mystery behind the groom’s disappearance.

Equip yourself for absolute chaos with a collection of bizarre, custom-built weapons. Set devastating traps, blast enemies with rapid-fire fruit, or deploy snapping, bouncing rabbits from a magician's hat. Tailor your heroes with more than 20+ randomized enhancements, including everything from Combat Veils to Bulletproof Dresses, making certain that every journey into the clown syndicate's territory is a distinct adventure.

Don’t walk the aisle alone—team up for 2-player couch co-op to mow down enemy armies together. Originally developed for the Sega Genesis, Lethal Wedding features authentic pixel aesthetics and a pulsing chiptune soundtrack. Enjoy a story that explores the intricacies of mother-daughter bonds and wedding stress, all brought to life through lovingly rendered animated cutscenes.
